story: [emotion:QT/calm] Sophie is in the garden with her mum. They are looking at the red flowers near the fence. [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie sees tiny wings behind a big green leaf. A small fairy is sitting on the leaf! The fairy has a shiny wand and three little stars on her dress. [gesture:stretching] Sophie reaches out her hand. The fairy steps onto Sophie's fingers. [emotion:QT/happy] Mum gives Sophie a chair to sit on. Sophie and the fairy are sitting together in the garden. Mum is watching and smiling. [emotion:QT/happy]
